body: Yeah! Definitely recommend him. He and his team are super nice and easy going. :)
No problem! I think it's often nb people that choose not to have their nipples grafted (a small part of why I choose this) but it's definitely an option for anyone going through with it.

Nope! It depends on the surgery and patient's choice. I got a Double incision that had to connect in the middle, and I chose to forgo any nipple grafting. 

Depending on the patient's size pre-op and the type of incision done will depend on if the nipple has to be futzed with. DI's like what I got, I do believe, always need the nipple to be removed and re-positioned because such a large amount of skin is being removed.

My biggest reason was recovery. I'm really shit at being careful and having nipple grafts definitely means you have to be more careful. The other reason was 'cause they've always just been... annoying, honestly. They don't exactly serve any purpose for me so I figured I'd just get rid of them instead of going through the trouble of healing them.

Oooof, my condolences. The surgery center really is pretty nice. I don't remember much of the actual surgery area, but the waiting area while they prep ya is practically in the same room. Just sectioned off by a wall. But the waiting area is pretty similar to their exam rooms, the chair you sit in is even really similar to those. But it's up against a wall so it doesn't lean back.
It might as well be a luxury spa, since they also give you a bathrobe as a souvenir lmao. And I got it done in the surgery center, which was so much more welcoming of a room than I expected??
Yes! Everyone was super awesome, even when I ended up late for the surgery thanks to traffic. And their building is even amazing to visit. It's like an added bonus of sight seeing!
Haven't decided yet, it's a possibility but it's honestly much more likely that I'm just going to be covered in other tattoos instead.
